'''March 2002 Austin tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Junior's Cards and Comics, Austin, Texas on 23 March 2002. [[Justin Warren]] won it. It is known from Jacob Taylor's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3535">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-03-25-austin-texas-03-23-02-senate-swarmd3535/ austin-texas-03-23-02-senate-swarm], DeckTech (Jacob "Armaedes" Taylor, 25 March 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-03-25-austin-texas-03-23-02-senate-swarmd3535/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 23 March 2002
* '''Site:''' Junior's Cards and Comics, Austin, Texas
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' [[Justin Warren]]
